Google.tip: Heavy focus on time/space complexity. Practice LeetCode Hard. Know your Big-O cold. Expect Googleyness questions about ambiguity and collaboration.

Amazon.tip: Amazon's 16 Leadership Principles are NON-NEGOTIABLE. Use STAR format for every behavioural answer. Expect questions on ownership, customer obsession, and delivering results.

Microsoft.tip: Strong emphasis on clean code and OOP principles. Expect design patterns. Growth mindset questions common. Coding bar is slightly lower than Google but SD is rigorous.

TCS.tip: Clear TCS NQT with high score (aim for 80+ percentile). Focus on core CS fundamentals, basic DSA, and DBMS. Communication matters significantly in the HR round.

Infosys.tip: InfyTQ certification helps significantly. Focus on Python basics, SQL, and project explanations. Specialist Engineer role needs stronger coding. Clear verbal communication is key.

Flipkart.tip: Flipkart has a very high DSA bar — close to FAANG. Focus on LeetCode Medium-Hard. E-commerce scale problems common in system design. Strong backend knowledge is a plus.

Wipro.tip: Focus on aptitude speed and accuracy. Basic programming, OOP concepts, and DBMS are tested. Elite NTH track has a higher coding bar. Good communication is highly valued.

Swiggy.tip: Strong focus on real-time systems and distributed architecture. Expect delivery/logistics system design problems. Product thinking matters — understand Swiggy's business deeply.

Razorpay.tip: Razorpay has a very high bar for system design — especially around payments, consistency, and reliability. Understand ACID properties, distributed transactions, and idempotency.

FAANG (General).tip: Practise LeetCode Medium-Hard daily. Prepare system design for 1 hour open-ended problems. Your behavioural answers must show measurable impact. Prepare 5-7 STAR stories.
